digest.component_or_area: Code scanning (CodeQL) analysis and secret logging
propositions: CodeQL alerts 86 and 87 flag logging of secret_override families field, but that field contains only constant detector category names from SECRET_PATTERNS table, not credential values, due to SecretFinding dataclass deliberate design with no value field.

CodeQL alerts 83, 84, 85 flag CLI usage error prints as tainted because _extract_allow_secret return value inherits secret label, but the --allow-secret-pattern flag token is stripped from rest before being printed, so the flagged value cannot reach the three print statements.

Regression tests pin the invariant that credential values and override reasons never appear in logs or usage error output, while detector family names and rejected argument tokens remain present for diagnostic value.
All 5 CodeQL alerts are dismissed as false positives via code-scanning API with evidence-backed justifications, leaving 0 open alerts for py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data rule.
